title: Detailed tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='42' ry='7' fill='#2a4a6b'/>
  <!-- back pole / ridge support -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#c8a44a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- main tent body left panel -->
  <polygon points='50,22 10,82 50,82' fill='#e85d4a'/>
  <!-- main tent body right panel -->
  <polygon points='50,22 90,82 50,82' fill='#d94a38'/>
  <!-- left panel shading stripe -->
  <polygon points='50,22 30,62 50,82 30,82' fill='#c93e2e' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- right panel shading stripe -->
  <polygon points='50,22 70,62 50,82 70,82' fill='#a82f24' opacity='0.3'/>
  <!-- seam highlights on panels -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='10' y2='82' stroke='#f28a7a' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='90' y2='82' stroke='#f0a090' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- front door opening -->
  <polygon points='50,40 36,82 64,82' fill='#3a2010'/>
  <!-- door flap left -->
  <polygon points='50,40 36,82 44,82 50,58' fill='#b03428'/>
  <!-- door flap right -->
  <polygon points='50,40 64,82 56,82 50,58' fill='#c43c2e'/>
  <!-- door flap highlights -->
  <line x1='50' y1='40' x2='44' y2='82' stroke='#e86a5a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='40' x2='56' y2='82' stroke='#e86a5a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- ridge pole top cap -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='3.5' fill='#f0c04a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='1.8' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- guy lines left -->
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='6' y2='78' stroke='#e8d090' stroke-width='0.9' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='4' y2='86' stroke='#e8d090' stroke-width='0.9' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
  <!-- guy lines right -->
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='94' y2='78' stroke='#e8d090' stroke-width='0.9' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='20' x2='96' y2='86' stroke='#e8d090' stroke-width='0.9' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>
  <!-- left tent stake -->
  <polygon points='5,84 2,90 8,90' fill='#9a9a9a'/>
  <rect x='4.2' y='83' width='1.6' height='5' fill='#b8b8b8'/>
  <!-- right tent stake -->
  <polygon points='95,84 92,90 98,90' fill='#9a9a9a'/>
  <rect x='94.2' y='83' width='1.6' height='5' fill='#b8b8b8'/>
  <!-- base trim left -->
  <polygon points='10,82 50,82 50,84 9,84' fill='#a03020'/>
  <!-- base trim right -->
  <polygon points='50,82 90,82 91,84 50,84' fill='#8a2820'/>
  <!-- little pennant at top -->
  <polygon points='50,20 62,24 50,28' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <!-- window on left panel -->
  <polygon points='30,52 38,52 36,64 28,64' fill='#a8d8f0'/>
  <polygon points='30,52 38,52 36,64 28,64' fill='none' stroke='#e8f4ff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='52' x2='32' y2='64' stroke='#e8f4ff' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <!-- window on right panel -->
  <polygon points='62,52 70,52 72,64 64,64' fill='#a8d8f0'/>
  <polygon points='62,52 70,52 72,64 64,64' fill='none' stroke='#e8f4ff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='52' x2='68' y2='64' stroke='#e8f4ff' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <!-- ground line detail -->
  <line x1='8' y1='86' x2='92' y2='86' stroke='#3a5a7b' stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='3,3'/>
</svg>
